payload.title: Planner session holds shard and closed piece at once until the position units land
payload.body: Until planner-position and mav-position land, the projected planner session holds both vocabularies. Its design and plan skills hand it a shard: one concept with its closure, stating what and why but never how. Its own agent description and role cell still say it decomposes one closed piece, a cut-piece it is given. The mav description still cuts the design into closed pieces, and the comment in roles/hold.ts still has the architect hand a cut piece to a planner. I observed this in a claude projection of the worktree (/tmp/tmp.wedXWhYc5J), whose design and plan skill sources match 82de7562. These surfaces belong to the planner and architect positions, not to the design shard.
